parsed.why: Self-ID law, facility access by identity, enforced hate-crime aggravation with convictions, official tolerant travel advice and tourism certification; only regional rollback and conservative attitudes outside cities temper an otherwise strongly protective, documented record.

No criminalisation, no prison system, no documented visitor incidents; but governing doctrine condemns transition, denies anti-discrimination protection, and hostile institutional framing with thin data leaves severity low but acceptance undocumented.

No criminalisation, third-gender recognition and active courts, yet documented frequent harassment and discrimination of visibly trans people in public spaces, rising political hate speech, and weak implementation of protections.

Life-imprisonment criminalisation used as a lever: documented witch hunts, forced anal examinations, police torture of LGBT detainees, website blocking, and a brutal trans activist attack with state inaction.

New nationwide criminalisation under military rule with deportation of foreigners and a promotion ban; no prosecutions yet, but criminalising regime, no recognition, no recourse and witch-hunt fear imply severe exposure if outed.
